summary: Approximately 267,667 km² and about 2 million people (2017), from Wikidata's Q1000 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Gabon", at revision 1376065311, opens: "Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country on the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, lying on the equator. It is bordered by Equatorial Guinea to the northwest, Cameroon to the north, the Republic of the Congo to the east and south, while sharing a maritime border with São Tomé and Príncipe to the west in the Gulf of Guinea. It has an area of 270,000 square kilometres (100,000 sq mi) and a population of 2.6 million people." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 481 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1960 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Libreville. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1960-08-17. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
